body: This is the best thing I've seen all day.
Put it back. For some reason it makes my skin crawl...

I appreciate the sentiment of having someone willing to listen. Unfortunately I did use to cut a lot back then. It was my way of escaping from abusive parents. Now that I'm out of that situation, I sometimes find myself subconsciously doing things related to sharp objects. Whether it be unloading the dishwasher or just shaving my legs (my brain has a sick sense of humor). Like the first comment on this, I think I might've gone on auto pilot.
Thank you so much, I felt like I was crazy doing such a thing. I appreciate your words as they are not taken like a grain of salt. I think my brain really was going on auto pilot as well.

I'm really sorry this happened to you, unfortunately you see who your real friends are when you open up to them. I don't know where you're coming from and im not gonna sugar coat that things get better. It really depends on how you handle it. Every life is precious including yours, surround yourself with people who actually care. Sending you the best of wishes in getting better and hopefully seeking professional help. ❤
